scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=functions
scripts.test:rules: scripts/with-java.sh npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npx vitest run tests/rules/firestore.rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:functions: scripts/with-java.sh npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "npx vitest run functions/src scripts"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run lint && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run build && npx firebase deploy
